data.context: In the 2024 IP Australia Economic Research Paper 14, *Raising the Bar reforms: Measuring the impact on relative patent scope*, this section uses word-count differences for Australian patent claims compared with European and US patents to examine trends in relative scope before and after the RTB reforms, across examination request years 2000–2019. Figure 7 compares first claims and all claims; the following analysis estimates the share of Australian patents classified as relatively broader.
